rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday word for someone or something strongly disliked.

example.english: I find this arrangement really detestable.
example.traditional: 我真係好討厭呢個安排。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 tou2 jim3 ni1 go3 on1 paai4

rows.note: Use this especially for a person whose irritating or obnoxious behaviour makes them detestable.

example.english: They are always showing off in front of people, which is truly detestable.
example.traditional: 佢成日喺人哋面前炫耀，真係乞人憎。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 jyun6 jiu6 zan1 hai6 hat1 jan4 zang1

rows.note: Use this when the detestable thing is gross, disgusting, or offensive to the senses.

example.traditional: 你唔好再用嗰條核突嘅抹布啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 jung6 go2 tiu4 wat6 dat6 ge3 mut3 bou3 laa1
